governance.ceo_comp_source: Sampo Remuneration Report for Governing Bodies 2024 (FI optional disclosure)
governance.ceo_comp_note: FI optional disclosure. Magnusson served as CEO until 30 Sep 2025; succeeded by Morten Thorsrud 1 Oct 2025. 2024 fixed salary ~EUR 1.0M + 2024 STI EUR 0.86M earned + LTI vesting + pension; total estimate ~EUR 2.5M. Full 2025 figure pending 2025 Remuneration Report.

_notes: FI issuer. Board reduced from 9 to 8 at 2025 AGM. ~64% foreign/nominee-registered shareholders, free float very dispersed.
